title: Story-state triggers: bots act as a story moves between states (M)
description:
Bots act as a story moves between states. Smallest first version: one automation fires on one state (for example copy -> copywriter), writes a new revision and moves the story on, with the idempotent claim and the hop limit. Budget and further states come after use shows what is needed.

Scope:
- An automation fires on "story entered state X".
- One claim per (story, state, revision), so runs are idempotent.
- A bot writes a new revision, then moves the story on. Wherever human input is wanted, it raises a review request (human review points story); the state itself never signals "needs a human".
- Bot transitions are labelled as bot actions.
- A per-story limit on bot hops and a per-story budget, to prevent loops.

Acceptance criteria:
- Entering the configured state starts exactly one run per (story, state, revision), even if the event is delivered twice.
- The bot's revision and transition are recorded and labelled as bot actions.
- A story exceeding its hop limit or budget stops with a review request instead of continuing.
- Bots skip stories under a group lock once the similarity story lands.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required.

Depends on PPY-433383, the automation records story (PPY-2e6e2b) and the human review points story.

comments.text: First version landed on develop in PR 674 (merged, CI green; nothing deployed, not promoted). Event automation story.stage_entered with onStage/nextStage/limits.maxHops (stored in trigger.config and limits, no schema change); CLI: papyrus automations create --on-stage S --next-stage T --monitor M --publication P --max-hops N. Contract: input {story, version, versionNumber, stage, runKey, automationId, hop} over static input; output {version} or {hold, reason}; same version back = no changes and still advances; extra keys kept on the run record. Engine (runner) moves the story to nextStage as automation:<id>, labels the version botAction, and fires the next stage (chain). Failure/timeout/hold/no version: story stays, flag review request. One run per story/stage/version via conditional put of STAGE# row. Hop limit default 5 (record maxHops): hard-gate review request 'bot hop limit reached'. Fires from stories move, save-version --stage/--advance, stories create, engine moves; papyrus stories fire-triggers for console moves and retries. Remaining: per-story budget cap (botChain.costUsd reserved, not written), group lock, firing from console board moves, sweeper for deferred starts, runner IAM (list/get Automation, write Items/Messages/ReviewRequest, invoke itself) plus runner image deploy, Tactus editorial-check tool (other agent).
